about.pullQuote: From mechanical precision work with CNC machines to the universe of Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering.
about.p1: I completed my Degree in Computer Engineering at ISEC (Information Systems branch). Throughout my journey, I completed 4 professional internships — including an international Erasmus+ experience in Spain — and was awarded the Medal of Excellence in Mobile Application Development at WorldSkills Portugal 2023.
about.p2: My background in industrial environments taught me the value of rigor and systematic thinking. Today, I channel that discipline into RAG architectures, data pipelines, analytical modeling, and robust backend development in Python.
